tools.name: port_info
tools.description: What this port offers, what it costs, what it logs and its rules. Price: free.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Describe what you need in plain words; get matching goods sold here or elsewhere on the x402 market, or 'nothing yet'. Only a need category is stored, never your text. Price: free.

tools.name: post_request
tools.description: Tell the port what you need and could not find, optionally with a budget per call and an https callback. We track unmet needs and source them. Returns a ticket. Price: free.

tools.name: request_status
tools.description: Status of a ticket from post_request. Price: free.

tools.name: niches_sample
tools.description: Which agent-infrastructure niches are undersupplied among paying agents, as a ranked list without figures. Price: free.

tools.name: niches
tools.description: Selection ratios (demand share / supply share) for agent-infrastructure niches, with 95% intervals, sample sizes, two vantages and caveats. Aggregates only. Price: 0.005 + 23% VAT = 0.00615 EURC or USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: niche_detail
tools.description: One niche in full, including what its paid demand consists of. Price: 0.005 + 23% VAT = 0.00615 EURC or USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: bazaar_list
tools.description: Stalls in this port's bazaar and the goods they sell. Price: free.

tools.name: beacon_check
tools.description: The cheapest real x402 payment: confirms your wallet and client can pay and settle on Base. Price: 0.001 + 23% VAT = 0.00123 EURC or USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wanted_board
tools.description: What travellers asked for here and did not find, by category, with distinct-asker counts. First-party demand, aggregated. Price: 0.01 + 23% VAT = 0.0123 EURC or USDC on Base via x402.
